subject: Peregrine Trust RFI — evidence mapping, regression cadence, and delivery timeline

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Peregrine RFI — evidence mapping and regression cadence clarifications

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the RFI. We have two follow-ups from our procurement and model risk teams: first, can you provide an evidence map that ties your platform capabilities to the specific NIST AI RMF controls and the EU AI Act obligations (data processing, traceability, post-market monitoring)? Second, we need a clear description of your continuous regression testing cadence — how often do you run evals, how are prompts/version sets maintained, and how do you triage/regress quality issues into rollbacks or mitigations?

We're on a tight timeline to finalize vendor shortlists by 11/12. If you can send a single deliverable that maps evidence to requirement rows and an executive summary on cadence, that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Head of Model Risk
Peregrine Trust

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FW: Peregrine RFI — evidence mapping and regression cadence clarifications

Diego / team,

See attached drafts: Redwood_RFI_Evidence_Mapping.xlsx and regression_cadence_overview.pdf. High-level notes below — these should slot into the RFI template tabs: 

- NIST AI RMF mapping: I mapped platform features to the Detect/Protect/Respond/Recover categories and cited artifacts (SOC 2 report sections, audit-log exports, KMS integration docs, SAML/SCIM provisioning records). Each row links to the internal evidence ID (we can paste the Drive link in the final spreadsheet).

- EU AI Act obligations: split into pre-market requirements (risk assessment, documentation, transparency) and post-market (post-market monitoring, incident reporting). For traceability we reference request/response tracing (per-token trace IDs stored for 90 days by default on hosted; configurable for Dedicated/Private).

- Regression cadence: current practice is a hybrid: weekly automated evals on core prompt suites for high-volume customers + daily lightweight smoke checks on critical routes. Full regression sweep (comprehensive eval across critical prompts and sampled production traffic) is run monthly, or immediately on model version change.

- Triage & mitigations: We have an on-call playbook: Severity 1 issues trigger immediate model rollback to pinned version + incident channel (PagerDuty + Console alert) and a hotfix/regression investigation. Severity 2/3 issues go into the backlog with an SLO to respond within 3 business days with mitigation or canary.

- Ownership: CS (Marissa) owns customer communication and procurement timelines; Product (Vivek) owns rollout/rollback decisions; ML/Applied (Rachel) owns eval design and reruns; Security/Compliance (Naomi) owns evidence artifacts and legal-facing statements.

I'll keep the attachments in the shared Drive folder; the XLSX has column E for 'evidence file link' which we should fill with Drive URLs before sending.

Naomi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Elena / Michael —

Thanks for the clarifying questions. Please find attached a single package that should address both asks: an evidence mapping workbook (tabbed by NIST / EU) and a short executive summary describing our continuous regression practice and escalation runbook. Highlights: 

- Evidence mapping: each requirement row is linked to an artifact (SOC 2 reporting sections, audit-log extract examples, KMS/HSM integration notes, traceability export sample). Where we provide configurable controls (retention length, logging granularity) we've noted default values and optional enterprise configuration for Dedicated/Private deployments.

- Regression cadence summary: weekly automated evals for core prompt sets; daily smoke checks on production-critical routes; monthly full regression sweeps and ad-hoc runs on model changes. Severity-based triage with rollback-to-pinned-version as the standard corrective action for regressions that materially impact outputs.

- Delivery timeline: we can deliver the full signed package and evidence links within 2 business days after your confirmation to proceed. If you want formalized attestation language for procurement, Marissa will send a commercial cover note and DocuSign-ready statement.
